messages:
alex: hi 👋 day 2 here. hitting permission errors when trying to access project redwood-eu-ps. specifically: can't view Billing page (403) and attempting `aws sts assume-role` into acct 333444555666 fails with AccessDenied. any pointers?
rita: welcome alex! for the GCP billing 403 usually means the project isn't linked to a billing account or you lack billing.user on the project. what's the project id?
alex: redwood-eu-ps. tried `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` and didn't see roles/billing.user.
cloud-ops: i'll open an ops ticket to link billing if needed. tagging finance to confirm billing account.
finance: thanks @cloud-ops. i checked — redwood-eu-ps is not associated. please put the request in infra-ops with justification.
cloud-ops: created ticket CR-3201 to attach billing-account 0000-EEE-FFF to redwood-eu-ps. alex, after linkage you should get access to Billing page.
alex: thanks. about AWS assume-role — CLI error is `Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole`. i'm in okta group devs-us but not devs-eu; role arn is in account 333444555666.
rita: likely okta group mapping. devs-eu needed for the SAML assertion. @cloud-ops can add alex to devs-eu and re-sync.
cloud-ops: added alex@redwood.dev to okta group devs-eu and synced. try assuming the role now.
alex: trying... now works! can assume arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/RedwoodOnboardRole ✅
finance: quick note: if you spin up GPUs, tag resources with cost_center=onboarding. ping me for spend alerts.
alex: will do — thanks everyone, billing page visible and AWS role fixed. closing thread.
